# The British Green Witch

> The official companion website for the Modern Witchcraft & Wicca books by Mark Hutchinson. These are books for sale (paperback, Kindle and, for one title, hardcover) on Amazon UK and Amazon US, plus free A4 printables for The British Green Witch's Almanac 2027.

The series is unnumbered. The books stand alone.

## Free guides
Free, sourced reference pages for green witches in Britain and Ireland. Dates and times are in UK clock time (GMT/BST) and each page lists its sources.
- [Guides index](https://britishgreenwitch.co.uk/guides/): the list of free guides.
- [The Wheel of the Year in 2026 and 2027: UK dates and times](https://britishgreenwitch.co.uk/guides/wheel-of-the-year/): all eight festivals; exact solstice and equinox times in GMT/BST for 2026 and 2027 (from timeanddate.com, cross-checked with the US Naval Observatory); traditional and astronomical cross-quarter dates; an honest history of the Wheel. Yule 2027 is 22 December in the UK (solstice 02:42 GMT).
- [2027 moon calendar for the UK](https://britishgreenwitch.co.uk/guides/moon-calendar-2027-uk/): all 13 new moons and 12 full moons of 2027 in UK time; folk moon names labelled as North American almanac names; seasonal blue moon 20 May, Harvest Moon 16 September; eclipses visible from the UK (penumbral lunar eclipse 20 February; partial solar eclipse 2 August 2027, with city times and safety advice).
- [A beginner's guide to green witchcraft in Britain](https://britishgreenwitch.co.uk/guides/beginners-green-witchcraft-britain/): what green witchcraft is and is not, a four-week starter plan, the British seasons, plant and foraging safety, and UK foraging law in brief (not legal advice). No medical claims.
- [FAQ](https://britishgreenwitch.co.uk/guides/faq/): 15 short answers about the books, practice, safety and the law, and the website.
